sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch bank-fix (ad6a2dd; chest-ledger + tool-keeper-2 + craft-count + 3 parts) rebased onto the fleet sha at launch
notes: THE BANK FIX BUNDLE (owner 09-29: withdraw-home bundled with the bank fix; toolkeeper-01 KEPT and folded in). The town chests were saturated (124,894 items, 42% cobblestone; 51 of 62 canary tool deposits 'the chest is full'; 70 of 79 full-chest failures HOLDING a chest while the recovery crafted one). OWNER 09-28 tiers: valuable uncapped / useful <= 128 per item per container under 75% full / bulk <= 64 under 50% / junk never; only a valuable item opens a new chest; place a carried chest before crafting. Built with both engines' design amendments (STATE.md 09-28) and both implementation reviews (Claude + Codex, 09-29, every finding fixed), sandbox-proved by RCON: A places the carried chest and banks ONLY the valuables; an empty chest takes exactly 64 cobblestone; capped bulk sends nobody back. Also: demand vs transfer (logs/cobble never send a bot), a closed-bank state (capped or full, 30 min, reopened only by a valuable item), hold 3 iron, withdraw skips bulk, place() never on a lid, and the Codex triage fixes (deposit walk cancellable + bounded, a named deposit admitted on its own plan, craft checks ingredients before walking to a table). Bundled branches: toolkeeper-01 (KEEP), withdraw-home, chest ledger (observe-only; its row now carries tiered server counts), craft-count. MEASURED: inventories median 34/36 slots but bulk is ~3.6% of slots -- ballast and spent tools fill them (hygiene). KNOWN RESIDUAL: nothing frees a slot for a bot full of capped bulk. 209/209, ~25 mutants killed.

licence.note: Written only by this build, once per container a deposit opens. The baseline has no such row kind.

draw_exposure.note: Fleet 29 Sep: 2.24-2.44 deposits/bot-h, ~0.28 successful. min 10 in 3 h keeps a pool that never deposits out.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 5 canary deposits paired with the server's before/after open snapshots AND the pairing saw a limited item. ~0.28 successful deposits/bot-h -> ~5 pairs in ~4 h on 5 bots if the next open follows.

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS, SERVER TRUTH: a canary deposit left an item above its tier limit AND above what the container held before it (the depositing bot's own ledger OPEN row before; the next open after). Judged on >= 5 pairs. Sandbox control: the pre-tier code into a chest of 60 cobblestone is a violation; the bank fix is not.
CORRECTNESS: a new chest made with no valuable item waiting (owner: only valuable items may open a chest).
POSITIVE CONTROL: a paired after-state held a limited item. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: deposits, storage_full and successful deposits per bot-h (DiD), bots at 36/36 slots, travel cancels, craft preflight skips, bank_capped refusals. Path A (a new chest for a valuable item) fires ~never on 5 bots (3 of 80 bots hold any iron) -- it is proved on the sandbox, not here.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. Name: bots at 36/36 slots rising (the known residual), deposit repeat loops, deposit_surplus skips.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. After a KEEP + promotion: the ONE-TIME chest clear (owner 09-28), shown to the owner first, slot-by-slot RCON before and after.
